brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：推得出 ⊥ 的，推出来；推不出的，一直归结到再也没有新子句。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that reaches ⊥ where it follows, and where it does not, resolves until no new clause appears.

hint.zh: 一轮之后，新子句之间可能还有能消的。
hint.en: After one round, the new clauses may still have pairs to cancel.

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="au-refute"></level-ref>里，每一步消哪一对由你挑。证明助手不挑：新元件「一轮归结」把能消的每一对都消一次，新子句加进来，并记下它由哪两条得出。子句里有变量时，一对文字先合一再消：「¬x是人 ∨ x会死」和「苏格拉底是人」，x 合一为苏格拉底。
t.en: In <level-ref to="au-refute"></level-ref> you chose which pair to cancel at each step. A proof assistant does not choose: the new card “a round of resolution” cancels every pair that can be cancelled, once, adding each new clause along with the two it came from. When clauses have variables, a pair of literals is unified first, then cancelled: “¬x is human ∨ x is mortal” and “Socrates is human”, with x unified to Socrates.
